name: Mizuhara Touko
source:
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy (a member of the art club)
Hobbies: Drawing picture books

Kuchiki Touko’s best friend. They spend a lot of time together. She has a severe inferiority complex due to being a poor girl in a school of wealthy, well-to-do young ladies. As a result, she hates herself, her mother, and everyone else around her. Mizuhara practically worships Kuchiki Touko because she’s the only girl that ignores her background. She holds a grudge against Reiji because he gets close to her friend.

”Stay away from Touko, please.”

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=79]MangaGamer[/url]]
